script:
control-agent-server conversation send "$T" --text 'hi' --no-run
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$T/run" --expect 200 --check success eq true
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$T/events/count" --query kind=$ACTION_KIND --check . eq 1 --until-ok 30
TCALL=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$T/events/search" --query kind=$ACTION_KIND --field items.0.tool_call_id)
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$T/interrupt" --expect 200 --check success eq true --expect-max-ms 4000 --timeout 60 --save F05.interrupt-tool-call/interrupt
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$T" --check execution_status eq paused
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$T/events/search" --query kind=$AGENT_ERROR_KIND \
  --check items len-eq 1 --check items.0.tool_call_id eq "$TCALL" --save F05.interrupt-tool-call/agent-error
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$T/events/count" --query kind=$INTERRUPT_KIND --check . eq 1
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$T/events/count" --query kind=$OBSERVATION_KIND --check . eq 0
control-agent-server fixture llm-stub --name qa-f05-tool --step 'tool:finish:{"message":"QA_F05_TOOL_RESUMED"}'
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$T/run" --expect 200 --check success eq true
control-agent-server conversation wait "$T" --until finished --timeout 60
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$T/agent_final_response" --check response eq QA_F05_TOOL_RESUMED
control-agent-server sink read --name qa-f05-tool --contains 'Tool call interrupted before completion' --expect-min 1 --save F05.interrupt-tool-call/resumed-request
